page.layout: One printed block: a bookplate in the centre of the page with an engraved coat of arms above and three lines of printed text below it. Handwritten shelf marks in the top margin are not printed text and are left out.
page.notes: Engraving of a coat of arms with crown, two lions as supporters and two flags, placed above the printed lines; not transcribed. Handwritten pencil marks at top left ("A.gr.b. 2106") and top centre ("Lascaris") are manuscript shelf marks, not printed, and are omitted. The printed lines are set in a bordered frame with a dashed line near the bottom.
